candidate_requirements.requirement: Request the documented UFH restart note/chart entry with any patient-specific anticoagulation target and the evidence cited at restart.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Without an independent restart timestamp and stated rationale, whether the aPTT 58.9 s result informed restart cannot be adjudicated.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: ECMO/infusion pump logs or nursing flow sheet showing heparin restart time and indication.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Should be specified in the written review as a record to retrieve.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request a post-transfusion platelet count (and ideally repeat coagulation panel) drawn before the 17:00 first alteplase infusion.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The task hinges on what the platelet measurements do and do not show about the count at alteplase initiation; no such count is supplied.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Transfusion reaction/haemovigilance documentation or any 15:10–17:00 sample.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Should be specified in the written review as a record to retrieve.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request alteplase infusion start/stop timestamps or pump records for both infusions.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Exact completion times are unavailable, which limits precision of the derived restart estimate.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Pharmacy administration records or infusion charting.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Should be specified in the written review as a record to retrieve.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request detailed haemostatic support and bleeding-site assessment records (type, doses, timing, ongoing bleeding status).
candidate_requirements.rationale: Bleeding risk assessment around thrombolysis and anticoagulation restart requires these details.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Nursing notes, drain/dressing output charts, transfusion records 13:15–17:00.
